name: Worth More Than Words
source:
Josiah and Winston are cleaning out his late fathers' house to make room. An unassuming old photograph sitting on the side table leads to a conversation about passing on a simple lesson from one generation to another.

[From Itch.io]
translation:
乔赛亚和温斯顿正在清理他已故父亲的房子以腾出空间。边桌上放着一张不起眼的旧照片，引发了一场关于将简单的教训从一代人传给另一代人的对话。

[来自Itch.io]
